description: This file provides an implementation for the 'default' function used within a data processing pipeline, specifically within the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines the class PipelineFunctionDefault, which implements the PipelineFunction interface to handle default value logic in expression resolutions, including parsing and resolving parameters for the function.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionDefault
classes.description: Implements a pipeline function that provides default values when placeholders are unresolved. Handles parsing and applying default values in expression resolution within the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionDefault.DefaultFunctionSignature
classes.description: Defines the signature for the 'default' function, specifying parameter details and providing a singleton instance.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionDefault.DefaultValueParam
classes.description: Defines the parameter representing the default value for the 'default' function, including its name, type, and description.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function, which is 'default'.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature object describing the parameters for this function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the 'default' function logic by parsing the parameter and applying it if the input value is unresolved.

methods.name: parseAndResolveThrow
methods.description: Parses the parameters string and resolves it, throwing an exception on failure.
